newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police thwart right-wing demonstration.
newsitem.headline: German police thwart right-wing demonstration.

text.p: German police said on Sunday they had thwarted an attempt by about 90 right-wing extremists to hold an outlawed gathering on Saturday night.
Acting on a tip, police conducted identity checks and confiscated right-wing propaganda at the "musical event", and dispersed the participants.
Three individuals were taken into custody before the gathering, and seven more during the police action. All were later released.
An unspecified number face charges for using Nazi symbols, which are outlawed in Germany, and resisting a police officer.
The police did not say how many officers were deployed, but said they came from several jurisdictions in Hesse and North Rhine-Westphalia.
